question: What authorized REA or adjacent reverse engineering workflow adds independently verified actionable information beyond existing Framework Alpha Lab and Auto Trading owners, and what smallest custom-fit internal primitive merits a bounded trial?
hypothesis: Highest value lies in small source-proven primitives: independent-wallet lead time, executable sellability, or entity-aware exit chronologies, only if shown genuinely missing and reproducible beyond baseline.
baseline: Current S1-S9/Pons/Wallet Alpha/relationship resolver/forward evidence and #937 policy protocol; M4 Auto Trading PARTIALLY_READY with #1557 BROAD_SEARCH_BLOCKED; ordinary AST/browser and verified first-party raw EVM sources.
falsifier: The method already exists, REA host unavailable, novelty unverifiable, relevant backend data inaccessible, no incremental decision value versus raw/public baseline after latency and cost, or #1557/PIT/denominator blocks economic tests.
kill_condition: Stop without a new engine when there is no reproducible unique fact, permission/right unclear, incomplete source data, unaudited outputs or unverified spending; CLEAN_NOOP is valid.
required_analysis: Inventory existing owners, source hashes and in-flight PR overlap before assessing novelty.
Separate UI/browser contract observability, EVM bytecode inference, verified chain facts, proprietary vendor labels and unknown backend data.
REA on own CN vs ordinary AST/browser baseline; EVMole shared-engine dependence must prevent false independent corroboration.
Rank at most three small Alpha Lab custom-fit features: qualified wallets, sellability, entity-aware distribution, early project-to-CA.
Rank Auto Trading execution-realism/no-trade/exit/latency/strategy dissection but do not expand economic tests until #1557 and #885 gates.
Specify one bounded pilot, negative controls, exact owner and independent reproduction, not ten concurrent projects.
Preserve first-observed/knowledge time, full denominator, wallets with incomplete history, infrastructure exclusions and unknown states.
Bound API/API receipts and Actions budget under existing policies; inspect prior failures and value of information.
Adversarially falsify the top choice before proposing optional implementation; do not auto-promote or modify code.

Audit Alpha Lab top-ten sequential program and the R1 historical source-admission DATA_BLOCKED receipt. Distinguish first-party chain/pool/route evidence from hypothetical winner selection, never compute phantom fills.

evidence_requirements.clock: signal eligible only after all required observation and qualification times
evidence_requirements.wallet_semantics: transfer is not buy, token recipient is not transaction initiator, egress not realized sell
evidence_requirements.entity: shared CEX/bridge/router never proves common ownership
evidence_requirements.denominator: include losers, no-trade, no-launch, failed and missed rows
evidence_requirements.control: same clock, same venue, same costs, public-price-only champion
evidence_requirements.privacy: no HAR keys/cookies/private raw or paid sources published

suggested_spend.note: ceilings not authorization or available balance; no cost until released

title: REA Custom-Fit Research: Alpha Lab and Auto Trading
